# Vulnerabilities that are real, unfixable today, and accepted on purpose.
# One ID per line; everything after '#' is the reason. Anything not listed
# here fails the build.

# Keep this list short and keep it honest. Delete an entry the moment the
# upstream pin moves — the weekly Security run prints the unfiltered report
# so a fixed entry does not sit here forever.

# --- pillow 11.3.0, reviewed 2026-09-07 -------------------------------------

# through moviepy/imageio for video and through python-pptx in the dev group.
# Re-check when moviepy ships a release without the <12.0 pin.
